column1: # The nutrient panel of catalogue v4 (docs/PLAN.md, decision 14): one column per row in foods, products and
# recipe_nutrition, all per 100 g (recipes: per serving), NULL = unknown. The column order is this file's order.
# Keys keep v3's names where they existed, so meal_log and the app's nutrient code carry over.
# carbs_g = total carbohydrate including fibre (USDA style); folate_ug = dietary folate equivalents; vitamin_a_ug = RAE.
# usda: USDA / Canadian Nutrient File nutrient numbers; eurofir: EuroFIR component codes and INFOODS tagnames that
# mean exactly this (|-separated). Codes that need a rule (available carbohydrate, retinol equivalents, kJ, total
# folate, single fatty acids) are left out here and handled in tool/catalog/normalize.py: derive().
# max: the most per 100 g a real food has (a little above the richest one); higher values are a wrong unit and dropped.
